_comment: The committed baseline for main's branch protection. `required` must equal the live required_status_checks.checks (context AND app_id) and `strict` the live strict flag; branch-protection-drift.yml compares them daily. `advisory_pending` are checks that run on every PR but are not yet required. Every name here is validated at PR time by .github/scripts/required_checks_guard.py (lint job): renaming one of these jobs fails `lint` instead of silently orphaning a required context. 15368 is GitHub Actions' app id.
